items.q: What should you remember about **Main flow sequence**?
items.a: **grill-with-docs → (prototype via handoff if a question needs a runnable** answer) → either /implement directly or to-spec → to-tickets → per-ticket implement with /clear between → code review vs spec + standards.

items.q: What should you remember about **Spec vs tickets**?
items.a: **spec = what the end state looks** like (destination); tickets = how you get there (journey); each ticket = one smart-zone session.

items.q: What should you remember about **Smart zone ~140K**?
items.a: **Matt's current working number for Opus 4.8 medium;** above it "attention degradation... weird hallucinations"; plan token budget per session ("we've got 100K of budget here").

items.q: Why does this matter: **One unbroken context window** for the whole main flow when work is small enough; skip spec/tickets entirely ?
items.a: **One unbroken context window** for the whole main flow when work is small enough; skip spec/tickets entirely for single-session work.

items.q: What should you remember about **User-invoked skills are context-cheap**?
items.a: **38 skills = 660** tokens; short precise descriptions; most skills don't leak into /context.

items.q: What should you remember about **Issue tracker agnostic**?
items.a: **works with Jira/Linear/Beads/GitHub/local markdown out of** the box; just tell setup which one; answers the #1 recurring user question.

items.q: What should you remember about **Team vs solo scope**?
items.a: **project-level skills so everyone shares** the same skill set and evolves it together; global fine for solo.

items.q: What should you remember about **Review in sub-agents, not main agent**?
items.a: **"agents are often really** bad at editing code or improving code they've just written".

items.q: What should you remember about **Grilling can start vague**?
items.a: **the skill does the heavy lifting; answer** questions until "we've walked the whole tree"; done in auto mode, not plan mode.
**Matt uses Claude Code + Opus** 4.8 medium + Whisper Flow dictation, but skills run across harnesses, models, effort levels.

items.q: What should you remember about **ask-matt as onboarding**?
items.a: **creator-as-skill; ask "how do I** get started?" and get the main flow prescribed with follow-ups.
